title: Input schema for ArXiv Research Synthesizer

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: ArXiv listing pages, category recent pages or search pages to start crawling.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests per Crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl.

downloadPdf.title: Download PDFs
downloadPdf.description: Whether to download PDF bytes and save them to Key-Value store.

minAbstractLength.title: Minimum Abstract Length
minAbstractLength.description: Minimum characters in abstract to include the paper.

maxPapers.title: Max Papers to Save
maxPapers.description: Maximum number of paper dataset items to save (stop earlier if reached).

includeCrossListings.title: Include Cross-listings
includeCrossListings.description: Whether to include cross-listed papers from other categories.
